name: Rainy Day Ideas
description: Twelve ideas for a short break when it is wet outside.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Twelve ideas for a break on a wet day, one at a time, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Do one idea, or none.
howToPlay: Read the idea and step away from the screen.
Press Another idea for a different one.
Press Back at desk when you return.
tips: Ideas are only suggestions. Dress for the weather if you go outside, and skip anything that does not suit you.
